endorsements.name: Rahad Chowdhury
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-47980
endorsements.description: Fuel CMS 1.4.13 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the 'col' parameter in the Activity Log interface. Attackers can send requests to the logs endpoint with malicious SQL payloads in the 'col' parameter to extract database information based on response time delays.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 7.1)

endorsements.name: Rahad Chowdhury
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-47981
endorsements.description: Quick.CMS 6.7 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the sliders form that allows authenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts by submitting XSS payloads through the sDescription parameter. Attackers can craft CSRF forms targeting the admin.php?p=sliders-form endpoint to execute arbitrary JavaScript in victim browsers when the form is submitted.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.4)

endorsements.label: CVE-2025-34504
endorsements.description: KodExplorer 4.52 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the user login page that allows attackers to manipulate the 'link' parameter. Attackers can craft malicious URLs in the link parameter to redirect users to arbitrary external websites after authentication.
